source_search.producer: original per-subject motion processing and original paper SI
source_search.verified_locator_detail: 2023 paper states >20% FD>0.4 over post-injection eight minutes, four static exclusions; further three full-scan exclusions. Git README offers motion parameters by direct request, not deposited in pinned tree.
discovery_only_queries: timmer500 DMT_Imaging fMRI motion parameters pseudonym
source_search.completion_test: Versioned source-producer FD/QA tables for 20 author-script IDs, exact post-bolus TR and n16/n13/n12 original analysis inclusion crosswalk
source_search.next_action: Inspect original PNAS SI and historical author-code commits for exact QC tables; preserve nonpublic custodian route as dependency but do not email or infer IDs

source_search.producer: original paper data availability + study consent/ethics + applicable repository permissions
source_search.verified_locator_detail: Original paper and public Git deposition establish access to a subset of files, not license for unrestricted use; conventional root LICENSE not located in pinned inventory.
source_search.completion_test: Specific provenance-backed distinction for reading/download, research computation, derived outputs, raw redistribution, privacy and permitted sharing
source_search.next_action: Review statements and rights provenance, fail closed on unverified redistribution; do not equate public checkout with a permission grant

source_search.producer: Christopher Timmermann original executable StaticGFC.m state
source_search.verified_locator_detail: Pinned author script cites author-local NIfTI/atlas and variables xdata, ydata, fdrcorrection, nets; literal script is not an independently verified complete execution.
source_search.completion_test: Original effective executed script revision, all upstream variable origins/tool versions, exact ROI index, scrub interpolation, averaging, statistic and result hash
source_search.next_action: Backtrack each unbound MATLAB variable to script/producer history, not inferred numerical output; attempt exact code archaeology before further bibliographic search

source_search.producer: original scanner preprocessing and image/atlas file producers
source_search.verified_locator_detail: Original StaticGFC calls cleaned post1 voxelwise NIfTI and Schaeff1007NExt.nii.gz; no matching NIfTI/mask in frozen 56-file tree; separate public parcelled BOLD_AAL MAT is not equivalent.
source_search.completion_test: Each required voxel image and atlas with source/hashes plus valid rights, time alignment, subject mapping and exact preprocessing
source_search.next_action: Acquire metadata/producer IDs first; only acquire restricted data after rights review; never substitute the parcelled MAT representation

source_search.producer: James W Sanders et al 2026 micro-phenomenology first-person phase coding
source_search.verified_locator_detail: Primary paper reports 23 interviews, 21 complete phase matrices and 125 categories. Supplementary A/B document analysis/categories; full participant phase matrices and underlying interview data are available upon reasonable request, not already recovered.
source_search.completion_test: Actual phase×category matrices, complete codebook and adjudication instructions, phase timing, allowed-use terms, overlap with 2023 cohorts established or explicitly unknown
source_search.next_action: Inspect public supplementary appendix as public methodological object; separately record request-only phase matrices and subject-overlap uncertainty; no email

source_search.producer: 20 paired original DMT/placebo AAL MATLAB arrays in exact Git source tree
source_search.verified_locator_detail: 40 paired fMRI MAT source identities are pinned, not locally analysed; separate representation and not a prerequisite for original static NIfTI GFC.
source_search.completion_test: Rights-reviewed, per-file Git blob+SHA256 local copy and data dictionary; label analysis exploratory_not_source_equivalent
source_search.next_action: Optional parallel lane only after rights determination; avoid diverting original GFC source recovery

fanout_preference: Prioritise one exact primary acquisition that pays multiple typed consumer obligations, not secondary-citation frequency. No scalar expected-information-gain estimates without empirical cost/likelihood data.

known_impossibilities.scope: pinned 56-file repository excludes required original NIfTI/atlas
known_impossibilities.reopen: new source scope with correct data; cannot relabel the old pinned tree
new version/scope or exact original function, not fiat known-absent->present

declared_not_verified: DDC or QID for particular scientific concepts

exit_rules.phase1: QC, metadata and licensed/allowed-use boundaries validated source-specifically; where author data are unavailable, produce a bounded negative provenance receipt, not global nonexistence
exit_rules.snowball: Stop branch when it yields only citations/motif analogies without new primary object, transformation, measurement or falsifiable discriminator
exit_rules.pareto: Recalculate only following a verified source-state change; maintain incomparable source objects/consumers
exit_rules.ontological: Neither source search nor reanalysed neuroimaging changes independent-conscious-entity status
